project.title: Pilot-scale verification on ex-situ magnetic separation and reuse of magnetite during anaerobic digestion of food waste recycling wastewater
project.description: Effect of magnetite addition with ex-situ magnetite recycling (using magnetic seperation) on anaerobic digestion process was verified in pilot-scale reactor treating food waste recycling wastewater.
project.center_name: Ulsan National Institute of Science and Technology (UNIST)
